# FORGE Super-agent architecture correction

Date: 2026-11-16. Starting commit: `4b220d8`. Frontend is outside this change.

## Architecture decision

FORGE builds its own general-purpose DeepSeek-style Super-agent. Its product is
one continuous Router conversation with independently executing hidden Workers.
Quest, DAG, team contracts, approvals and evidence are internal infrastructure.
The Router dispatches independent tasks; it does not do detailed task execution.
An execution Worker may use a team internally. Codex and Claude Code inform the
execution harness, context and permissions, rather than the overall architecture.

Primary basis: [DeepSeek Harness article](https://x.com/DeepSeekHarness/status/2116857257245987236),
especially sections 2, 3, 5 and 6, and [official prototype](https://github.com/DeepSeek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)
at `8c32a9dc5d72c033816c6a8110b37f40cf94fba4`.
The article describes more than the public, single-repository DSH plugin implements.
FORGE adopts the two-layer principles, not its GitHub-only deployment or DSH backend.

## Completed differential audit

Detailed source evidence is in [DeepSeek research](SUPERAGENT_DEEPSEEK_RESEARCH.md),
[harness audit](SUPERAGENT_HARNESS_AUDIT.md) and
[validation baseline](SUPERAGENT_VALIDATION_BASELINE.md).

| Concern | Existing foundation | Gap and minimum correction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Persistent Router | Stable `main`, Router ID, durable turns, snapshot/CAS, compaction | Add autonomous delegation to the actual Core lifecycle; keep the Router lightweight |
| Isolated Workers | Hidden session, per-run messages, leases and budgets | Add private per-task execution directories; keep approved input and receipt checks |
| Event triggers | Transactional events/Outbox, Inbox, fenced delivery, retries/dead letters | Durable source/Thread/Trigger intake with code admission and semantic cold-start decisions |
| Subscription/pass-through | Worker commands target one Worker | Many-to-many Thread subscriptions, direct follow-up delivery and explicit handback |
| Inline/Spill | Full message archives, exact hashes and bounded source reads | Apply bounded previews plus complete external content references to triggers/recall |
| Chain of Recall | Sourced lexical/semantic recall, archive links | Typed, bounded traversal across Thread, Trigger, Quest, Worker, event, source and project references |
| Persistent state | SQLite migrations and atomic state/event commits | Persist new trigger/subscription/mandate/watchdog state; use existing contracts and recovery |
| Watchdog | Background exception retry and Worker lease recovery | Independent supervision task, persisted health, timeout/task-exit detection, safe recovery |
| Workspaces | One authoritative workspace binding, optional labels | Generic local manifest/directory discovery and task association, independent of GitHub |
| Model intelligence/teams | Capability provenance, speed/cost, bounded composition | Reuse selection for autonomous independent task assignments rather than ask users to pick Agents |

The initial worktree was clean. The existing Registry, settings, workspace scope,
provider configuration, composition, transaction and migration baseline passed
163 tests. A configured local Provider proxy answered authenticated model discovery
and advertised the configured DeepSeek model; generation is still to be validated.

## Minimum-change implementation sequence

1. Add durable Trigger/Thread subscriptions and bounded full-content readback;
   reuse the existing transaction, event and Worker Inbox mechanisms.
2. Add typed Chain of Recall and private Worker execution directories; expose
   bounded read tools to the Router and Worker while preserving authorization.
3. Add a trusted host delegation mandate for new conversational tasks. Create
   a minimal internal execution contract and select a Worker through the existing
   Model Intelligence Registry/Composer. A mandate never impersonates `local_user`,
   grants external action approval or expands the existing workspace boundary.
   Existing manual plans and authenticated approvals retain their behavior.
4. Connect cold-start semantic filtering, direct follow-ups, timer/file/external
   intake and results to the single Router. Persist intake deduplication and
   processing state so restarts do not create duplicate tasks or lose events.
5. Connect an independent Watchdog and generic workspace association to Core
   startup/shutdown. Recover only replay-safe work; unresolved effects remain
   unresolved and block replay under the existing evidence mechanisms.
6. Test migration/rollback, dedupe/fanout/handback, scoped readback, autonomy
   boundaries, concurrency, restart, supervision and integration. Run bounded
   real Provider scenarios and retain redacted results, actual usage, failed
   observations and explicit limitations. No synthetic result counts as live.

## Acceptance

One user conversation accepts new work while hidden Workers run concurrently.
New work is dispatched without asking the user to manage sessions or allocate
Agents. Follow-up events reach subscribed Workers without Router inference.
Worker results return through the Router. State and object references survive
restart. Watchdog detects and handles crashes/timeouts without replaying unknown
side effects. Cross-project continuity uses recalled references rather than
requiring repeated task explanations. High-risk tool authorization is still
enforced at execution, independent of autonomous task scheduling.

No frontend rewrite, external runtime dependency, cosmetic Manager layer,
deletion of historical evidence, or manual Entire checkpoint is part of this plan.

# DeepSeek Super-agent：官方依据与 FORGE 架构差异审计

审计日期：2026-11-16。本文是后端重构之前的基线审计，不表示下列缺口已经修复。

## 研究依据与边界

- 官方架构文章：[Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System](https://x.com/DeepSeekHarness/status/2116857257245987236)。读取了 DeepSeek Harness 官方账号发布的完整英文机译正文（页面注明中文为原文），包括第 1–9 节；这里的依据是技术文章，并非另一个已经验证的学术论文。
- 官方原型：[deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)，固定源码版本 [`8c32a9dc5d72c033816c6a8110b37f40cf94fba4`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype/tree/8c32a9dc5d72c033816c6a8110b37f40cf94fba4)。源码仅克隆到系统临时目录，没有添加为 FORGE 运行依赖。
- 重点读取原型 README、`docs/000-philosophy.md`、`001-domain.md`、`002-authorization.md`、`003-execution.md`、`007-architecture.md`，并核对 `src/core/intake.ts`、`src/app/assessment.ts`、`src/app/cards.ts`、`src/app/context.ts`、`src/app/runtime.ts`、`src/app/sessions.ts`、`src/executor/dsh.ts`、`src/app/retry-health.ts`、`src/infra/health.ts`。
- FORGE 基线：当前 README；`router.py`、`router_domain.py`、`runtime.py`、`dispatcher.py`、`event_domain.py`、`worker_runtime.py`、`worker_recovery.py`、`worker_schema.py`、`migrations.py`、`project_context.py`、`tool_engine.py`、API 启停与后台循环。Context/Memory 的独立审计应与本文合并使用。

官方 README 明确说这是研究原型，非 DeepSeek 官方产品，且公开代码与内部版本、文章描述不完全相同；有些设计仍属未来方向。不能把文章每一项能力都说成原型已经实现，也不能把原型的软件工程细节当成 FORGE 必须照搬的接口。

## 产品方向必须采用的结论

文章第 1 节定义四个特征：Continuous、Productive、Proactive、Persistent。中心不是一张任务图或多个 Agent，而是用户始终面对同一个能够持续工作的实体。第 2.1 节进一步区别 Super-agent Router 与单任务 Agent Team Lead：Router 保持全局顺序点、记忆和交互，只调度独立任务，不深入分解和执行每项任务。复杂任务内部可以由 Worker 自己组织 Team/DAG（第 2.2 节），而这些执行细节不应成为用户管理 Session 的负担。

因此 FORGE 可以继续保留 Quest、计划、团队合同、审查和审批记录；它们是执行与权限基础设施，不能再决定产品交互的主语。现有可靠数据库和证据机制不需要推翻，缺的是把这些基础设施自动连起来的事件驱动控制流。

## 文章、原型与 FORGE 的逐项差异

| 模块 | 官方文章要求 | 官方原型源码证据 | FORGE 重构前状态与差距 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Persistent Router | 第 2.1 节：长期主 Session，所有外部交互与跨任务协调；轻量、不执行任务；积压事件可批处理 | `src/app/runtime.ts` 的启动流程调用 `sessions.ensure(masterId, stateDir, ..., 'orchestrator')`；候选与结果通过持久 Effects 投递到同一个主 Session | `store.ensure_router()`、`router_state`、`router_turns`、CAS 和上下文归档已经存在。`RouterService._commit()` 创建 Quest 提案后默认等待 review；`continue_quest` 仅关联状态，不向正在运行的 Worker 交付后续指令。需要从“分类并登记提案”变成“授权范围内创建、订阅、推进任务并总结结果” |
| Isolated Workers | 第 2.2 节：独立任务独立上下文、执行工具；Worker 不直接对用户说话；复杂 Worker 可以包含团队 | `src/executor/dsh.ts` 的 `workerSessionId`、`ticketExecution`、`prepareDirectory`、`launch`：每 Ticket 一个持久 DSH Session 与目录；`docs/003-execution.md` 解释并发槽与后台工作 | `WorkerManager` 有持久 run/messages/capsule、所有权 lease/generation、有限修复、证据；Worker 绑定 `plan_id/node_key/team_digest`，`WorkerScheduler.tick()` 从 approved plan/team 寻找任务。`ToolEngine` 多个 subprocess 的 cwd 仍是全局 `store.workspace.root`，上下文隔离不等于执行目录隔离。需要补任务环境描述与目录边界，保留现有权限验证 |
| Fast Path / Slow Path | 第 3.1 节：确定性来源/actor/规则过滤；只有需语义判断的候选进入模型；第 2.1 节支持积压合批 | `Intake.receive()` 先 `scope.scope(trigger)`；`Policy.gate` 决定确定性准入；`MasterAssessor` 提供模型 assessment；`Evals` 按 Thread 串行并合批 | `EventEnvelope` 与 Dispatcher 有类型/引用校验、优先事件、持久投递，但事件主要来自内部 Quest/Worker 生命周期，缺少通用来源、外部事件身份、线程及准入策略。`handle_pending_events()` 只处理固定通知类型，并仅合并同 Worker 的 progress。需要统一 Trigger 入口和来源级确定性过滤，复用现有事件与 Outbox |
| Thread Subscription / Pass-through | 第 3.2 节：Thread 与 Worker 多对多；同一流后续事件直接扇出；不相关事件可 handback；输出仍经 Router | `src/core/intake.ts:Intake.receive` 读取 `thread.subscriptions`、持久 Input 扇出、人类 follow-up 有 owner 时不进入 Eval；`docs/002-authorization.md` 明确订阅仅传递上下文，不赋新权限；`Tickets.handback` 重新排队 | `Dispatcher._routable()` Worker 分支只接受 `WORKER_COMMANDS` 且 `row.worker_id == consumer.worker_id`。没有 Thread/Subscription 持久关系。`WorkerManager.deliver()` 有去重 inbox，但不是自动订阅路由，且 16 KiB payload/64 inbox 上限须配合 Spill。需加小型订阅表和原子扇出到现有 Worker inbox；订阅绝不等于权限 |
| Inline & Spill | 第 3.3 节：对象摘要、必要邻接信息内联；长文留外部可寻址存储，提供继续读取引用 | `cards.ts` 的 `triggerCard/ticketCard/ticketDetails/threadCard/decisionCard` 带 preview、read、关联 ID；`textPage` 返回精确分页和 next_offset；`assessment.ts` 将正文、邻近消息和 stub 分别限额 | FORGE 已有 ContextService、source IDs、精确 source framing、worker source reads 和 compaction，应复用；新 Trigger/Thread/订阅结果也必须给出可解析引用，不能只截断 payload 后丢原文。模型输入可以压缩，原始事件/结果不能被破坏 |
| Chain of Recall | 第 3.3 节：从当前对象沿 Trigger→Thread→Worker→其他 Thread 等关联逐跳恢复上下文；每次 recall 继续返回邻接引用 | 原型未命名独立“Recall Manager”，但 `cards.ts:ticketDetails` 已返回 origin trigger、decision、threads、assignments、inputs、result、transcript 等资源链；相应资源按需读取 | FORGE 有任务、消息、证据与记忆来源的关联，并支持检索；重构前缺少 Trigger/Thread/Worker 订阅对象链与统一的可读对象资源协议。应为现有对象补引用投影，不能用一个全新向量库或总结代替可靠源记录 |
| Persistent State | 第 5.1 节：compute 可替换，Session 状态独立持久；不能把 in-memory task 当真相 | `Engine` 在事务中写领域对象与 durable Effects；`Runtime` 先目录锁、再 Store；DSH session persistence 分开承担 session log；`DshExecutor.resume()` 从存储恢复 Assignment | FORGE 已有 SQLite 顺序迁移、事务 Outbox、Inbox、lease/fencing、CAS、worker checkpoint、预算 ledger、未知外部效果处理。这些是现成优势。需持久化新增 Trigger/Thread/订阅、过滤结果、调度与 supervisor 状态；恢复时不能重放未知效果 |
| Watchdog | 第 6 节：独立于主系统的外部 Control Loop/Watchdog Session，基础设施存活与任务实质进展都要检查，可处理瞬时故障并继续复查 | 固定版本未发现独立 Watchdog Session 或目标偏移判断；`HealthBoard` 和 `RetryHealth` 是状态投影，`docs/003-execution.md` 定义 transient retry 与重启恢复，不等于完整文章 Watchdog | `forge_api.main._core_lifespan.run_loop()` 捕获异常重试并写内存 `background_health`；`WorkerScheduler.tick()` 回收过期 lease。没有独立 supervisor、持久 heartbeat、卡住后台 task 的替换、环境探针或跨组件任务进展审计。应先补可恢复外部监督边界；只加一个 health endpoint 不能宣称达到第 6 节 |

## 必须明确区分的未实现与部署约束

1. **原型运行在 DeepSeek Harness 上。** `Sessions`、inbox、后台 shell/subagent 等底层能力依赖 DSH 包，FORGE 必须自行实现对应 Harness，不能把调用 DSH CLI 当成自己的 Worker Runtime。
2. **原型默认单 GitHub repository。** GitHub/Feishu 是 Source 实现，概念本身可复用，不能把 Source/Thread 设计退化为 GitHub-only；FORGE 的非 Git Workspace、文件、定时、终端、浏览器、MCP、GPU 是自己的扩展。
3. **完整独立 Watchdog 不在固定原型中。** retry-health 不检查 Worker 是否偏离任务目标；观察到 retry/health 代码不能据此说已实现文章第 6 节。
4. **云 Agent Loop、BYOM endpoint daemon 与跨设备恢复属于文章架构方向。** 固定原型的本地目录和 DSH Session 管理不证明其已经实现文章第 5 节全部部署形态。FORGE 用户要求本地优先，可先把执行环境接口与持久状态分开，无须新增云服务。
5. **目录隔离并非安全沙箱。** 原型文档明确 Executor 以操作者 OS 身份执行命令、无需逐命令审批。FORGE 不应照搬这一权限默认，应保留自己的 scopes、intent/receipt、审批和 restore fence。
6. **原型保留条件性人类介入。** `Mandate` 表达授权范围，外部输入不能改变权限；超出范围的 follow-up 要 handback，不是默认自动执行所有评论。消除频繁内部 plan/team 确认不等于删除外部动作权限。
7. **原型允许操作员直接打开 Executor Session。** 这是调试/接管能力，不能当作 FORGE 日常产品入口；用户仍应只与 Router 对话。
8. **文章实验不能证明通用任务正确率。** 第 7.1 节 coding work 为耗时模拟，5 次运行主要测调度；pass-through 的总 cache-read tokens 从 31.8M 降到 23.2M，但任务耗时基本一致。第 7.2 节 Router 用真实模型、Worker 用 mock。FORGE 自身的真实 Provider 测试必须单独记录。

## 最小改动顺序

1. **把原有可靠机制作为不可回归的底座。** 保留 Router CAS、事件与 Outbox 同事务、lease/fencing、未知外部效果的保守恢复、权限 scopes、工具证据和预算账本。新增对象只进入现有迁移链，不启用另一个数据库或 Manager 层。
2. **统一 Trigger 与 Thread。** 在现有事件系统旁补少量关系表，持久记录来源、外部 identity、Thread、准入结果、关联对象以及必要原文引用。来源适配只产生事件，不直接执行工具。过滤结果同样可审计、可去重。
3. **打通订阅与 Worker inbox。** 新任务启动时原子建立订阅；后续同 Thread 事件原子扇出，不必每次 Router 推理。Worker 对超范围事件提供 handback；Router 能观察概要而不重新决策全部 follow-up。明确终态/暂停/取消/手动停止语义，防止恢复已撤销任务。
4. **把 plan/team 审批从日常入口收回内部。** 先提供受 trusted host 策略约束的自动计划/组队/启动链路，仍调用原来的合同校验。Router 不获得伪造用户审批能力；需要用户决定的高影响动作仍停在现有真实授权边界。多个独立任务应创建多个隔离 Worker，任务内 DAG 继续存在。
5. **补执行环境与对象 Recall。** 先支持本地普通目录、Git 可选，给 Worker 固定执行上下文与 artifact 位置；保持来源只读和显式写授权。Trigger/Thread/Quest/Worker/decision/event 的摘要附关联 ID、内容长度与可精确分页读取地址，沿引用恢复历史。
6. **监督实际运行。** 后台组件定期写持久 heartbeat；独立监督循环识别 task 已退出或长期不推进，恢复安全任务，保留未知效果停顿。检查执行环境可达性。再在具备证据的边界上增加模型进展判断，不能用未经证明的总结自动终止工作。

## 本轮实施所需验收证据

- 零模型调用地过滤不匹配来源，去重同一外部事件；候选才进入 Router Slow Path。
- 两个独立任务得到不同 Worker 上下文和执行目录；同 Thread 多订阅可扇出；重复投递不产生重复 inbox 消息。
- 初始触发后连续 follow-up 进入原 Worker，Router 的 Provider 调用数不随同 Thread follow-up 增长；手回 Router 路径可用。
- 真实 Provider 从用户入口接收任务，能够自动启动隐藏 Worker、接收结果并由同 Router 汇总；记录模型、配置、调用/使用量与失败，区分真实和 mock。
- 关闭并重开同一数据库后 Router identity、订阅、未读消息、Worker checkpoint、原始对象与事件去重状态保持。
- 对后台 task 异常退出、租约超时、环境不可达、已知可重试失败和未知副作用分别测试；未知效果不得自动重放。
- 大正文经 Inline & Spill 后可按引用完整重建；历史对象至少完成 Trigger→Thread→Worker/Quest→执行记录的多跳恢复。
- 现有事务、CAS、审批、证据、预算和工具权限测试必须回归；前端文件保持不变。

此文只报告研究和重构前证据，未运行原型，也不把静态阅读当作真实模型或端到端验证。

# FORGE Super-agent：底层 Harness、Context 与 Memory 审计

审计日期：2026-11-16。本文记录重构前源码事实和最小修复建议；不把参考项目视为 FORGE 的执行后端，不把单一功能或单元测试视为最终产品验收。

## 1. 依据与来源边界

FORGE 的总体产品目标来自 DeepSeek Super-agent。Codex 与 Claude Code 只提供底层执行、上下文、持久化和权限机制参考。

本轮读取的官方仓库快照：

| 来源 | 固定版本 | 实际读取范围 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [openai/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex) | `5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129` | `codex-rs/core`、`protocol`、`exec-server`、`rollout`、Windows sandbox 与文档 |
| [anthropics/claude-code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code) | `ebbbadc9617ebe177d22bf64876981159a01e6a7` | README、CHANGELOG、公开设置及 hooks 示例、LICENSE |

参考克隆位于系统临时目录 `forge-superagent-harness-20261116`，没有引入项目依赖或修改前端。Claude Code 的公开仓库不是其完整核心 Harness 源码；本文对其执行循环和压缩行为的结论来自官方文档，不能描述为已经审计了私有实现。在线文档读取于审计日，不与以上 Git commit 绑定。

官方文档：

- [How Claude Code works](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works)：工具反馈循环、JSONL 会话、自动压缩、独立子上下文。

- [Permissions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions) 与 [Memory](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory)：权限配置、持久项目指令与跨会话学习。

## 3. FORGE 重构前事实

| 模块 | 已可靠实现的基础 | 差距与影响 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context_service.py` / `context_schema.py` | SQLite 保存完整原消息；archive/capsule/source hash；Router snapshot 与 archive frontier；model handoff 的 `previous_archive` 引用链；原子提交；Worker 工具请求和响应整组压缩 | 已接近 Inline & Spill 的存储基础。但完整 message archive 不等于任意外部事件、工具大结果、任务交接都统一使用 spill 引用；应统一对象引用与按需 readback |
| `model_compaction.py` / `worker_model_compaction.py` | 真实模型摘要有独立预算和 Gateway usage 结算；摘要绑定完整输入和 frontier；失败保留原上下文；不重置累计 usage | 保持这些约束，不能为“自动压缩”增加未记账调用或在未结算时重试 |
| `memory.py` / `semantic_memory.py` / `router_recall.py` | 有界 lexical/semantic 检索；来源哈希、撤销、时效、冲突与现行 revision 检查；记忆保持 hypothesis/来源信任标签；来源索引随事务更新 | `source_refs`、`related_quest_ids` 和 archive handoff chain 尚非通用 Chain of Recall。缺少 task → worker/session → event → receipt/artifact → decision/project 的可遍历关系 API。当前 revision 过滤也不适合把过往事实与“当前授权”混为一类 |
| `worker_schema.py` / `worker_runtime.py` | 每个 run 独立 messages、capsule、inbox、provider/model、预算、lease token/generation；有界并行；lease/CAS 保护提交；过期运行可重新 claim；不确定工具结果阻止重放 | 这是会话和所有权隔离。尚无每个 Worker 绑定的执行目录、环境身份、文件变更交接及执行环境恢复记录 |
| `tool_engine.py` | exact intent/receipt、权限验证、工作区路径约束、脱敏环境、`shell=False`、输出与执行超时上界；不确定执行恢复为 `uncertain` | Python 固定 subprocess 的 cwd 仍是共享 `workspace.root`，Git 使用批准路径；没有一般任意 shell/浏览器/GPU 工具执行器。AST 子集测试是受限解释器，不是通用 Python 环境或完整 OS sandbox |
| `project_context.py` / `settings.py` | 单个数据库绑定一个稳定 workspace；workspace metadata 不授予文件权限 | 显式声明 `multiple_workspaces=False`，没有通用项目自动识别和跨项目关系。不能把现有 Quest 分组标签描述成项目发现或全局 Router |
| `forge_api/main.py::_core_lifespan` | dispatcher/router/planner/composer/worker/verifier 的独立后台循环、异常重试与退避、健康字段；恢复 fence 和 WorkspaceLock | 循环内异常会重试，但外层没有监测 task 意外完成/取消、长期卡住操作及重建子循环的 watchdog。健康字段仅表示最近一次 tick，不能代表持续前进 |
| `WorkerScheduler` / `worker_recovery.py` / `ToolEngine.recover_abandoned` | 从数据库查找待执行/过期 run；重整已结算 usage；识别 unresolved calls；保留不确定副作用边界 | 不能用统一“自动重试”覆盖这些差别；watchdog 应调用现有恢复入口并记录原因，无法证实无副作用的动作仍须保留 blocked/uncertain |

当前源码已经支持“摘要外置完整来源”的重要部分；缺口是把这些对象串成持续事件驱动系统。增加另一个 MemoryManager、SessionManager 或图数据库不会自行补齐该缺口。

## 4. 最小修改顺序

1. 在现有数据库与 `MemoryService` 上增加有界 `recall_object`/`recall_chain` 查询。对象引用使用显式类型与稳定 ID；返回来源、关系、trust、当前状态和读取指针。优先读取已有外键和事件字段，不复制权威业务表。限制深度、节点数、UTF-8 字节数和关系分页，循环用 visited set 截断。历史事实可以可见，但旧 approval/receipt 绝不自动授予当前权限。
2. 在现有 ContextService 与事件存储上统一 Inline & Spill。小的核心字段、摘要及对象引用内联，完整事件/工具交接外置；readback 重新校验 hash、workspace/run scope、offset 与 byte bound。spill 存储失败与事件提交必须原子回滚。大 payload 不得静默截断成成功结果。
3. 在现有 Worker run 增加 execution environment 绑定，Core 创建私有 scratch/output/cwd，并为通用 Workspace 记录关联根。共享文件的读写继续经过现有 grants/intents/receipts；仅有私有 scratch 目录不能被称为完整 OS sandbox。后续引入进程能力前，明确 Windows 本机、WSL/container 等边界和实际验证平台。
4. 扩展当前后台生命周期为 watchdog：记录最近开始/完成时间、连续失败、运行 generation 和恢复事件；发现退出 task 后重建原循环，识别超时并取消受控操作。恢复继续使用已有 lease fencing、Outbox lease、Gateway usage settlement 和 uncertain handling，禁止盲目重放外部动作。
5. 将以上功能接入持久 Router 的实际工具及自动执行链：用户只交代目标，Router 选择角色和模型并组织隐藏 Worker。Quest、DAG、计划/团队授权记录保留为内部可审计合同；不要求普通安全任务先经用户逐个管理它们。

"""Bounded real-Provider acceptance through a fresh Core's authenticated API.

Supply the Provider credential in the process environment; this driver never
reads operator credential files. Published JSON contains allowlisted assertions,
usage and hashes, never raw prompts/replies, logs, secrets or database contents.
Offline tests are separate and are never reported as live success here.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import secrets
import sqlite3
import sys
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from contextlib import closing
from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "phase2"))

import live_core

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NOTICE_TYPES = (
    "worker.blocked",
    "worker.failed",
    "worker.result",
    "worker.help_requested",
    "approval.requested",
    "worker.command.cancel",
    "worker.progress",
    "quest.status_changed",
)


class ProbeFailure(RuntimeError):
    pass


def source_digest():
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    files = sorted((REPO / "backend" / "src").rglob("*.py")) + [Path(__file__)]
    for path in files:
        result.update(str(path.relative_to(REPO)).replace("\\", "/").encode())
        result.update(path.read_bytes())
    return result.hexdigest()


def snapshot(path):
    with closing(
        sqlite3.connect(f"{Path(path).as_uri()}?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=5)
    ) as connection:
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        rows = lambda sql: [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(sql)]
        messages = rows("SELECT id,role,content,metadata FROM messages ORDER BY rowid")
        return {
            "router": rows("SELECT router_session_id FROM router_state")[0]["router_session_id"],
            "quests": rows("SELECT id,status FROM quests ORDER BY rowid"),
            "workers": rows(
                "SELECT id,quest_id,worker_id,state,execution_mode FROM worker_runs ORDER BY rowid"
            ),
            "hidden": rows("SELECT hidden FROM workers"),
            "request_quests": rows(
                "SELECT q.id,json_extract(m.metadata,'$.request_id') AS request_id "
                "FROM quests q JOIN messages m "
                "ON m.id=json_extract(q.metadata,'$.original_request_message_id')"
            ),
            "subscriptions": rows("SELECT run_id,active FROM superagent_subscriptions"),
            "core_reads": rows(
                "SELECT run_id,tool_name,state FROM worker_tool_calls "
                "WHERE tool_name IN ('read_trigger','recall_object')"
            ),
            "calls": rows(
                "SELECT purpose,state,created_at,input_charged,output_charged "
                "FROM model_budget_attempts ORDER BY created_at"
            ),
            "receipts": rows(
                "SELECT i.run_id,i.tool_name,i.resource_scope,r.execution_mode,r.result_json FROM action_receipts r "
                "JOIN action_intents i ON i.id=r.intent_id WHERE i.state='succeeded'"
            ),
            "events": rows(
                "SELECT id,event_type,quest_id,payload,created_at FROM events ORDER BY seq"
            ),
            "router_notices": [
                dict(row)
                for row in connection.execute(
                    "SELECT e.id,i.processed_at,i.notice_dead_at FROM events e "
                    "LEFT JOIN event_inbox i ON i.event_id=e.id AND i.consumer_id='router' "
                    "WHERE e.event_type IN (" + ",".join("?" for _ in NOTICE_TYPES) + ")",
                    NOTICE_TYPES,
                )
            ],
            "messages": messages,
            "message_digest": hashlib.sha256(
                json.dumps(messages, sort_keys=True).encode()
            ).hexdigest(),
        }


def call(core, method, route, payload=None):
    result = core.call(method, route, payload, timeout=180)
    if result["status"] != 200:
        raise ProbeFailure(f"api_status_{result['status']}")
    return result["body"]


def notices_for_tasks(state):
    events = {event["id"]: event for event in state["events"]}
    result = set()
    for message in state["messages"]:
        metadata = json.loads(message["metadata"])
        event = events.get(metadata.get("event_id"))
        if (
            metadata.get("source") == "router_notice"
            and event
            and (
                event["event_type"] in {"worker.result", "quest.completed", "task.verified"}
                or (
                    event["event_type"] == "quest.status_changed"
                    and json.loads(event["payload"]).get("to") == "completed"
                )
            )
        ):
            result.add(event["quest_id"])
    return result


def guard_bounds(state, args):
    if len(state["calls"]) >= args.max_calls:
        raise ProbeFailure("model_call_ceiling_reached")
    if any(call["state"] in {"uncertain", "unknown"} for call in state["calls"]):
        raise ProbeFailure("unknown_provider_outcome")
    if any(
        call["state"] != "settled" and time.time() - call["created_at"] > 150
        for call in state["calls"]
    ):
        raise ProbeFailure("unsettled_provider_timeout")


def quiescent_since(state, ready, previous, *, now=None):
    """Require drained Router deliveries and an unchanged settled snapshot for 2s."""
    if any(item["notice_dead_at"] is not None for item in state["router_notices"]):
        raise ProbeFailure("router_notice_dead_lettered")
    if (
        not ready
        or any(item["state"] != "settled" for item in state["calls"])
        or any(item["processed_at"] is None for item in state["router_notices"])
    ):
        return None, False
    now = time.monotonic() if now is None else now
    signature = (len(state["calls"]), len(state["events"]), state["message_digest"])
    since = previous[1] if previous is not None and previous[0] == signature else now
    return (signature, since), now - since >= 2


def running_intervals(state):
    """Observed ownership intervals, not continuous compute or CPU utilization.

    A repeated claim without a durable closing fact cannot erase the earlier
    ownership observation. Provider-capacity waits may occur inside an interval.
    """
    active, intervals = {}, []
    closes = {
        "worker.result",
        "worker.blocked",
        "worker.failed",
        "worker.paused",
        "worker.cancelled",
    }
    for event in state["events"]:
        run_id = json.loads(event["payload"]).get("run_id")
        if not run_id:
            continue
        if event["event_type"] == "worker.accepted":
            active.setdefault(run_id, event["created_at"])
        elif event["event_type"] in closes and run_id in active:
            intervals.append(
                {
                    "run_id": run_id,
                    "started_at": active.pop(run_id),
                    "ended_at": event["created_at"],
                }
            )
    boundaries = sorted(
        (stamp, change)
        for item in intervals
        for stamp, change in ((item["started_at"], 1), (item["ended_at"], -1))
    )
    current, maximum = 0, 0
    for _, change in boundaries:
        current += change
        maximum = max(maximum, current)
    return intervals, maximum


def final_accounting(report, state):
    settled = all(item["state"] == "settled" for item in state["calls"])
    drained = all(
        item["processed_at"] is not None and item["notice_dead_at"] is None
        for item in state["router_notices"]
    )
    report["checks"]["final_provider_calls_settled"] = settled
    report["checks"]["final_router_deliveries_drained"] = drained
    if not settled or not drained:
        report["status"] = "failed"
        report.setdefault("failure_code", "final_provider_or_router_work_unsettled")


def verified_artifact(state, workspace, quest_id, expected_marker):
    run_ids = {worker["id"] for worker in state["workers"] if worker["quest_id"] == quest_id}
    for receipt in state["receipts"]:
        if receipt["run_id"] not in run_ids or receipt["tool_name"] not in {
            "file_write",
            "file_revise",
        }:
            continue
        path = Path(receipt["resource_scope"]).resolve()
        if not path.is_relative_to(workspace.resolve()) or not path.is_file():
            continue
        data = path.read_bytes()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        if (
            expected_marker.encode() not in data
            or json.loads(receipt["result_json"]).get("sha256") != digest
        ):
            continue
        if any(
            read["run_id"] in run_ids
            and read["tool_name"] == "file_read"
            and read["resource_scope"] == receipt["resource_scope"]
            and json.loads(read["result_json"]).get("sha256") == digest
            for read in state["receipts"]
        ):
            return True
    return False


def run(args):
    credential = os.environ.get(args.credential_env)
    if not credential:
        raise ProbeFailure("provider_credential_environment_missing")
    run_id = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + "-" + secrets.token_hex(3)
    workspace = REPO / ".local" / "superagent" / run_id
    workspace.mkdir(parents=True)
    inputs = workspace / "inputs"
    inputs.mkdir()

FORGE 的总体产品目标来自 DeepSeek Super-agent。Codex 与 Claude Code 只提供底层执行、上下文、持久化和权限机制参考。

本轮读取的官方仓库快照：

| 来源 | 固定版本 | 实际读取范围 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [openai/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex) | `5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129` | `codex-rs/core`、`protocol`、`exec-server`、`rollout`、Windows sandbox 与文档 |
| [anthropics/claude-code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code) | `ebbbadc9617ebe177d22bf64876981159a01e6a7` | README、CHANGELOG、公开设置及 hooks 示例、LICENSE |

参考克隆位于系统临时目录 `forge-superagent-harness-20261116`，没有引入项目依赖或修改前端。Claude Code 的公开仓库不是其完整核心 Harness 源码；本文对其执行循环和压缩行为的结论来自官方文档，不能描述为已经审计了私有实现。在线文档读取于审计日，不与以上 Git commit 绑定。

官方文档：

- [How Claude Code works](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works)：工具反馈循环、JSONL 会话、自动压缩、独立子上下文。
- [Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents)：独立上下文、工具和权限约束、可恢复子任务、可选 worktree。
- [Sandboxing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing)：操作系统执行边界与 permission flow 是不同机制；shell sandbox 不包围文件工具、MCP 或 hooks；原生 Windows 当前不提供该 shell sandbox，WSL2 可用。
- [Permissions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions) 与 [Memory](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory)：权限配置、持久项目指令与跨会话学习。

## 2. Codex 可直接验证的机制

| 源码（上述固定 commit） | 已验证机制 | 对 FORGE 的意义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`core/src/tools/orchestrator.rs`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129/codex-rs/core/src/tools/orchestrator.rs) | 在执行前统一处理 approval、sandbox selection、network approval 和受策略约束的重试；sandbox 扩权重试须重新评价对应 authority | 复用 FORGE 既有 ToolEngine/governance 边界，不能因为 Router 自动委派就允许模型授权自己 |
| [`core/src/tools/approvals.rs`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129/codex-rs/core/src/tools/approvals.rs) | action 绑定 environment、cwd、command/patch/MCP 参数；要求人工的 checkpoint 不能由 hook 或自动审核替代 | 保存 exact scope 与权限来源；自动执行策略应由可信 Core 根据已授予能力决定 |
| [`core/src/unified_exec/mod.rs`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129/codex-rs/core/src/unified_exec/mod.rs)、`process_manager.rs` | 进程 ID、environment ID、受限输出缓冲、yield/poll、超时和取消；终端生命周期与模型推理分离 | 通用 shell/browser/GPU 任务需要持久进程身份与结果回收；当前 FORGE 固定命令 subprocess 不是这套能力 |
| [`core/src/session/environment.rs`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129/codex-rs/core/src/session/environment.rs) | 线程环境默认值、workspace roots、owner-provided 配置校验 | environment 应是有权限来源的实际执行记录，不能只在 Worker prompt 写“隔离” |
| [`core/src/session/compaction_replacement.rs`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129/codex-rs/core/src/session/compaction_replacement.rs) | 锁内校验 history generation、prefix 长度、auth owner，原子安装压缩前缀并保留期间新增 suffix | FORGE 现有 Router CAS 和 archive frontier 检查方向正确，应扩展而非替换 |
| [`core/src/compact.rs`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129/codex-rs/core/src/compact.rs)、`session/rollout_reconstruction.rs` | 区分模型可见压缩历史与完整 rollout；恢复选择有效 compaction checkpoint 和后续记录；压缩保留真实用户输入及必要上下文 | summary 不是事实数据库；完整来源与恢复 frontier 必须保留 |
| [`rollout/src/recorder.rs`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/5cb38e79842a0e0a6dca5bb97874163e8ee50129/codex-rs/rollout/src/recorder.rs) | 有序写入会话 JSONL，显式 persist/flush/shutdown 确认及错误传播 | FORGE SQLite event/outbox 已有更明确事务边界，不需要为模仿参考项目另建 JSONL 权威状态 |

Claude 官方文档支持相同的工具反馈、独立子上下文、持久 transcript 和摘要交接方向，也明确摘要可能丢失早期细节。FORGE 应保留现有的可验证完整来源、权限和证据机制，而不是复制“摘要即记忆”的弱实现。

## 3. FORGE 重构前事实

| 模块 | 已可靠实现的基础 | 差距与影响 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context_service.py` / `context_schema.py` | SQLite 保存完整原消息；archive/capsule/source hash；Router snapshot 与 archive frontier；model handoff 的 `previous_archive` 引用链；原子提交；Worker 工具请求和响应整组压缩 | 已接近 Inline & Spill 的存储基础。但完整 message archive 不等于任意外部事件、工具大结果、任务交接都统一使用 spill 引用；应统一对象引用与按需 readback |
| `model_compaction.py` / `worker_model_compaction.py` | 真实模型摘要有独立预算和 Gateway usage 结算；摘要绑定完整输入和 frontier；失败保留原上下文；不重置累计 usage | 保持这些约束，不能为“自动压缩”增加未记账调用或在未结算时重试 |
| `memory.py` / `semantic_memory.py` / `router_recall.py` | 有界 lexical/semantic 检索；来源哈希、撤销、时效、冲突与现行 revision 检查；记忆保持 hypothesis/来源信任标签；来源索引随事务更新 | `source_refs`、`related_quest_ids` 和 archive handoff chain 尚非通用 Chain of Recall。缺少 task → worker/session → event → receipt/artifact → decision/project 的可遍历关系 API。当前 revision 过滤也不适合把过往事实与“当前授权”混为一类 |
| `worker_schema.py` / `worker_runtime.py` | 每个 run 独立 messages、capsule、inbox、provider/model、预算、lease token/generation；有界并行；lease/CAS 保护提交；过期运行可重新 claim；不确定工具结果阻止重放 | 这是会话和所有权隔离。尚无每个 Worker 绑定的执行目录、环境身份、文件变更交接及执行环境恢复记录 |
| `tool_engine.py` | exact intent/receipt、权限验证、工作区路径约束、脱敏环境、`shell=False`、输出与执行超时上界；不确定执行恢复为 `uncertain` | Python 固定 subprocess 的 cwd 仍是共享 `workspace.root`，Git 使用批准路径；没有一般任意 shell/浏览器/GPU 工具执行器。AST 子集测试是受限解释器，不是通用 Python 环境或完整 OS sandbox |
| `project_context.py` / `settings.py` | 单个数据库绑定一个稳定 workspace；workspace metadata 不授予文件权限 | 显式声明 `multiple_workspaces=False`，没有通用项目自动识别和跨项目关系。不能把现有 Quest 分组标签描述成项目发现或全局 Router |
| `forge_api/main.py::_core_lifespan` | dispatcher/router/planner/composer/worker/verifier 的独立后台循环、异常重试与退避、健康字段；恢复 fence 和 WorkspaceLock | 循环内异常会重试，但外层没有监测 task 意外完成/取消、长期卡住操作及重建子循环的 watchdog。健康字段仅表示最近一次 tick，不能代表持续前进 |
| `WorkerScheduler` / `worker_recovery.py` / `ToolEngine.recover_abandoned` | 从数据库查找待执行/过期 run；重整已结算 usage；识别 unresolved calls；保留不确定副作用边界 | 不能用统一“自动重试”覆盖这些差别；watchdog 应调用现有恢复入口并记录原因，无法证实无副作用的动作仍须保留 blocked/uncertain |

当前源码已经支持“摘要外置完整来源”的重要部分；缺口是把这些对象串成持续事件驱动系统。增加另一个 MemoryManager、SessionManager 或图数据库不会自行补齐该缺口。

## 4. 最小修改顺序

1. 在现有数据库与 `MemoryService` 上增加有界 `recall_object`/`recall_chain` 查询。对象引用使用显式类型与稳定 ID；返回来源、关系、trust、当前状态和读取指针。优先读取已有外键和事件字段，不复制权威业务表。限制深度、节点数、UTF-8 字节数和关系分页，循环用 visited set 截断。历史事实可以可见，但旧 approval/receipt 绝不自动授予当前权限。
2. 在现有 ContextService 与事件存储上统一 Inline & Spill。小的核心字段、摘要及对象引用内联，完整事件/工具交接外置；readback 重新校验 hash、workspace/run scope、offset 与 byte bound。spill 存储失败与事件提交必须原子回滚。大 payload 不得静默截断成成功结果。
3. 在现有 Worker run 增加 execution environment 绑定，Core 创建私有 scratch/output/cwd，并为通用 Workspace 记录关联根。共享文件的读写继续经过现有 grants/intents/receipts；仅有私有 scratch 目录不能被称为完整 OS sandbox。后续引入进程能力前，明确 Windows 本机、WSL/container 等边界和实际验证平台。
4. 扩展当前后台生命周期为 watchdog：记录最近开始/完成时间、连续失败、运行 generation 和恢复事件；发现退出 task 后重建原循环，识别超时并取消受控操作。恢复继续使用已有 lease fencing、Outbox lease、Gateway usage settlement 和 uncertain handling，禁止盲目重放外部动作。
5. 将以上功能接入持久 Router 的实际工具及自动执行链：用户只交代目标，Router 选择角色和模型并组织隐藏 Worker。Quest、DAG、计划/团队授权记录保留为内部可审计合同；不要求普通安全任务先经用户逐个管理它们。

## 5. 验证要求

审计阶段只读研究，没有以真实 Provider 行为冒充已完成实施。后续实现至少需要：

- 原有 context/memory/worker/tool/lifecycle 回归，尤其 CAS 冲突回滚、来源篡改、跨 run/工作区拒绝、未配对工具消息保留和不确定副作用不重放。
- Chain of Recall 的关系遍历、循环/分页/字节上限、旧 revision 历史与当前权限隔离。
- 实际运行的大 payload spill/readback、重启恢复和 Worker 私有目录隔离；不能只验 DB 存在字段。
- 注入 Router/Dispatcher/Worker 后台 task 退出和卡住，验证 watchdog 真正重建、保留 fence/usage/receipt 状态。
- 真实配置 Provider 贯通一条用户目标 → 多个隐藏 Worker → 后续订阅事件 → Router 汇总 → 重启后对象引用回忆的链路，保存调用及证据；Mock 测试和真实 Provider 结果分别报告。

相关现有回归文件：`test_context_m6.py`、`test_model_compaction_v29.py`、`test_worker_model_compaction_v29.py`、`test_memory_m6.py`、`test_semantic_memory_phase2.py`、`test_worker_runtime.py`、`test_worker_tool_integration.py`、`test_tool_engine.py`、`test_worker_lifespan_m5.py`、`test_lifecycle_m7.py`。

## 6. 本轮后续实现与局部验证

本节区分已经实施的底层改动与上文记录的重构前状态。整体编排与真实 Provider 验收另见本轮总报告。

- `recall_chain.py` 和 `MemoryService.recall_object` / `recall_chain`：直接读取已有权威对象，支持 conversation、Router、Workspace、Quest、Worker、run、event、message、plan、approval、evidence、intent、receipt、memory、archive、Trigger、thread、source、project；不另建对象副本。返回有界摘要、规范 JSON 的 UTF-8 分片、哈希和下一跳。关系可分页，链遍历限制深度、对象数、总字节并检测循环。
- Recall 的 Worker scope 由可信 run ID 固定：拒绝其他任务对象及未投递的 Trigger，只允许本 run 的订阅/投递 thread、任务关联项目、原始及更新用户请求的来源绑定。用户请求重新核对 sha256；Trigger 与 receipt 核对完整内容 hash；archive 还验证保留的原消息。历史审批和记忆保持“历史来源，不授予当前权限”的标签。Caller-owned transaction 不被提交或关闭。
- `worker_environment.py`：从已持久化 Workspace / Quest / run ID 派生私有 work、tmp、output 目录；拒绝目录 symlink/junction；可使用调用者连接为尚未提交的 Worker 注入描述符。目录身份可在进程重启后重建。实际 Python/Git 固定进程工具改为使用 run 的 cwd 与 TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR，批准输入文件和共享输出依旧经过原 scopes/grants/intents/receipts。
- `gpu_tools.py` / `gpu_status` ToolContract：无参数 R0 只读诊断，使用系统 `nvidia-smi` 与固定 inventory 参数，复用受限进程 runner。缺少驱动工具或 NVIDIA 设备明确返回 unsupported，格式错误或超时返回 unavailable；保存实际诊断输出及哈希。不包含任意命令、GPU 运算或驱动安装。

局部回归命令：

```powershell
python -m pytest backend/tests/test_recall_chain_superagent.py backend/tests/test_worker_environment_superagent.py backend/tests/test_gpu_tools_superagent.py backend/tests/test_tool_engine.py backend/tests/test_worker_tool_integration.py backend/tests/test_memory_m6.py backend/tests/test_context_m6.py -q
```

结果：**78 passed, 1 skipped**（2026-11-16）。跳过项是当前 Windows 用户无目录 symlink 创建权限时的链接攻击测试；真实子进程相对文件隔离、私有临时目录、重启恢复、未提交 run 绑定、来源篡改、跨任务拒绝及分页均已通过。GPU 测试包含实际本机查询，检测到 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti；这只证明只读硬件诊断，不证明 GPU 计算能力。相关新增文件的 Ruff 检查及 `git diff --check` 通过。

Credential handling: the provider key is read from a process environment variable
named by FORGE_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_REF. Nothing secret is written to disk or logs.
"""

import hashlib

from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
BACKEND = REPO / "backend"
PYTHON = BACKEND / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"

PROVIDER_ID = "wb-local"
MODEL_ID = "deepseek-v4.1-flash"


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]

Workers and their reviews, verified both files, admitted a timer task, ignored
file noise and traversed Recall. Its report's intermediate checks all passed,
but another notice began between the settled check and shutdown. The final
ledger had one reserved call, so the published `passed` status is superseded by
the accompanying diagnostic and is **not final acceptance**. The probe now gates
final status on the post-stop ledger and waits for settled notification work.
Original reports are preserved; no failed or uncertain call is replayed.

Final responsiveness corrections keep new independent task admission stable
while unrelated Workers change runtime status. Conversation state, messages,
models, constraints, archive head, original task identities, selected recall and
consulted source checks remain fenced; existing-task intents retain the strict
snapshot check. Autonomous routine progress and nonterminal internal status facts
are acknowledged without model calls. Results, blockers, failures, help and
action approvals retain semantic handling.

An event arriving after Worker finalization cannot be attached to a task with
no accepting Worker. Router context exposes recipient availability, and the
transaction rechecks it. Invalid attachment rolls back the entire batch and
leaves the Trigger pending for retry or a new continuation dispatch. This covers
the separate gap between final publication and review completion.

Completed-task status queries now retain a natural Router recap when every
selected task is Core-completed and the current plan has succeeded Worker/node
deliveries. The bounded source summaries and their payload hashes participate
in snapshot validation; the answer carries task/event references. Manual,
unfinished, mixed-state or unsourced cases retain exact Core status facts.
The final Router compatibility, mutation and native-wire selection passed
**154 tests**. Autonomous context projection measures the actual nested JSON,
schema and tool framing, and retains the more conservative Core guard. It spills
only optional evidence, events and old messages, with typed Recall references;
user input, constraints, archive/capsule and completed source summaries remain.
The event cursor does not acknowledge spilled events that were not presented.
Legacy capacity handling and later tool-round budget checks remain intact.

Archive Recall now verifies complete previous-archive dependencies through the
existing ContextService verifier, including original source/index/scope/hashes,
cycles and link hashes. Revoking an original user message, internal Worker
message or previous archive blocks dependent recall, including legacy inherited
sources. The combined new archive, Recall and Core proof selection passed
**43 tests**. The final event, backpressure, proof, supervisor, Watchdog, project
and acceptance-driver selection passed **94 tests, 1 skipped**. These overlapping
selections are not a replacement for the complete regression result.

Real acceptance uses authenticated HTTP against isolated Core processes, the
configured `deepseek-v4.1-flash` local proxy, actual file/readback receipts and
durable model usage. Credentials come from process environment only, and are not
written to source or reports. Each driver is bounded to 32 calls, 500000 tokens
and 900 seconds. The proxy-reported upstream model identity is not independently
verified. Scripted protocol tests never count as real Provider evidence.

A further diagnostic, `20261115T192301Z-67cf20`, completed both tasks and reviews,
read their spilled follow-ups, verified artifacts, delivered Router results and
preserved restart state, with **23/23 settled calls, 115765 charged tokens**.
It still failed on the historical recap. The retained

reproduces a first-round context budget error without another Provider call or
database write. The new native/Core projection estimates **62095 bytes before,
61320 after**, under the unchanged **61440-byte input ceiling**. It spills one
evidence item and one event while retaining both completed summaries and the
original input. A separate interval-collection bug concealed overlapping Worker
ownership in that original report; the diagnostic records the corrected overlap,
and the final driver retains the first unclosed claim until a closing event.
Ownership intervals can include Provider-capacity waits, not continuous compute.

the earlier source snapshot and does not supersede the separate recap failure.

SHA-256, `388123662a3e14adcba343ee2d62c6eb84679a989a0f90780d7037efb27c277e`.
Neither reopens an uncertain prior run. Limits remain **32 calls, 500000 tokens,
900 seconds per scenario**, with final shutdown accounting and Router delivery
drain required for acceptance.

real file write/readback receipts, independent review, two direct Thread
continuations without Router Trigger inference, complete spilled source reads,
one Router delivering both results, and the same conversation/Router identity
after restart. The historical recap recovered both actual source markers without
including those marker values in the recap request or creating another task.

The cold-event scenario observed the Router selecting two independent
assignments/roles, persisted contracts and model selection, overlapping Workers,
both verified artifacts, timer dispatch, file-noise rejection, a source-bound
mandate, unified Router delivery and typed Recall links into execution. Every
call settled and every required Router notification drained in both scenarios.
These are actual configured Provider calls, not mocks; the proxy reports
`deepseek-v4.1-flash`, and its upstream identity remains unverified.

## Operating limits

- Private Worker directories are not an OS sandbox. Process isolation and tool
  authorization do not isolate an attacker with the same OS account.
- Automatic delegation currently uses a fixed local tool allowlist. Terminal
  inspection is a fixed Python-version probe; Python compilation and pure-function
  AST tests do not provide arbitrary shell, pytest, package installation or
  unrestricted program execution. Git support here is status inspection.
- The retained browser tool is allowlisted HTTPS GET, without rendering or
  interactive browsing. MCP is preconfigured HTTPS JSON-RPC `tools/call`, without
  general stdio/SSE discovery or session management. Both retain independent
  high-risk action authorization and are outside the autonomous default allowlist.
  The final live scenarios exercise file tools, not browser or MCP execution.
- Project discovery establishes identity and Recall continuity. It does not
  expand execution outside the configured workspace or grant project writes.
  Multiple explicit roots retain the neutral storage association.
- Autonomous dispatch allows at most four independent assignments; actual
  concurrency also respects the configured Core and Provider limits.
  Workers plan steps inside their own model loop; autonomous nested-team spawning
  is not implemented. Real acceptance uses one configured model for multiple
  roles and operator-supplied capability priors, not a capability benchmark or
  evidence of optimal selection across different models.
- Host contract allocation bounds are enforced. Cumulative token use is recorded,
  with stopping controlled by `FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS` (default `false`).
  The acceptance drivers explicitly enable their fixed cumulative budgets.
- Timers and file watches are registered by authenticated local host APIs and
  polled by Core. Natural-language creation of schedules/watches is not exposed
  as a Router/Worker tool. External ingress trusts the authenticated local adapter;
  no public webhook server, OAuth/signature adapters or built-in messaging
  connectors are added.
- Automatic whole-Core process restart applies to the default CLI launcher.
  Native `--desktop-host` and direct uvicorn execution do not gain that parent
  supervisor. A running but fully hung process is not automatically restarted.
- Complete Trigger ingress is bounded to 4 MiB; watched files to 1 MiB. Readback
  pages and Recall traversal are bounded, with explicit continuation references.
- GPU support is read-only status through fixed `nvidia-smi` arguments. GPU
  compute scheduling and OS/container security sandboxes are not implemented.
- Tool network access retains operator allowlists and independent action
  authorization. Scheduling a task cannot authorize an external side effect.
- Bounded real scenarios establish observed integration behavior. They do not
  establish arbitrary-task success, indefinite unattended operation or a
  packaged desktop release. The fourteen reproduced historical test failures
  remain visible technical debt.
